name: Mediate a multiparty conflict
short_description: Structure a mediated process among at least four parties and produce a documented agreement or precise impasse.
self_assessment: I can mediate four parties without help and document either their agreement or every unresolved issue.
description: Structure a mediated process among at least four parties and produce a documented agreement or precise impasse. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
